proof_body:
by
  intro n _ K _ _ _ ζ hζ h2 h
  have h1 : Algebra.norm ℤ (hζ.toInteger - 1) = 1 := hζ.norm_toInteger_sub_one_eq_one h2 (fun {p} hp k => h p k hp)
  have h3 := Algebra.coe_norm_int (K := K) (hζ.toInteger - 1)
  rw [h1] at h3
  rw [NumberField.isUnit_iff_norm]
  simp only [map_sub, map_one] at h3 ⊢
  simp at h3 ⊢
  rw [← h3]; simp
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ K] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n), 2 < n → (∀ (p k : ℕ), p.Prime → p ^ k ≠ n) → IsUnit (hζ.toInteger - 1)
